scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Israel raises his hands beside a smoking stone altar while a traveling household, laden animals, and sheep wait behind him in a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Israel's journey and sacrifices at Beersheba; the details of the people, altar, and landscape are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Jacob sits on bedding beside a lamp in a tented encampment at night, his hand on his chest as he looks toward light breaking through clouds in a starry sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jacob responding to God’s call in the visions of the night; the camp, lamp, and light in the sky are artistic details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly traveler with a staff sits among family and laden animals, looking toward a sunlit river valley with fields and distant Egyptian buildings.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the journey to Egypt and God’s reassurance; the landscape, people and lighting are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly traveler with a staff rests on a sunlit rocky rise, watching a group of people and laden animals descend a winding road toward a green river valley and an ancient Egyptian city.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes the promised journey to Egypt and God's accompanying presence. The winding road suggests the promise of being brought up again; Joseph placing his hand on Jacob's eyes is not pictured.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Jacob rides in a wooden cart alongside his sons, while women and children follow in another cart through a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the family setting out from Beersheba; the landscape, people, and arrangement of the carts are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Jacob travels with a large family, sheep and goats, and a donkey carrying bundles toward green fields and buildings in Egypt.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the family arriving in Egypt with their livestock and possessions; the people, setting, and details are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man travels with a large family of adults and children along a sunlit road, with a donkey and a river valley and Egyptian buildings in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family journey illustrates the verse's account of bringing his descendants with him to Egypt; its appearance and setting are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Jacob walks beside Reuben at the front of a traveling family, with a fertile Egyptian landscape in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined journey illustrates the verse's introduction to Jacob and his sons going to Egypt; the setting and moment are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man sits beneath a tree surrounded by four smiling adult men in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering illustrates the relationship named in the verse; the setting, appearance, and ages are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an older man sits with six younger men gathered around him; a woman rests her hands on the shoulders of one of the younger men.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering illustrates the relationships listed in the verse; the setting, appearances, and moment are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man sits affectionately with three younger men beneath a tree near tents in a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative family gathering illustrates the relationship named in the verse; the setting and appearances are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man sits beneath a tree with three adult men and two boys in a sunlit hill country; two stone mounds stand in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering and the stone mounds are an artistic interpretation of the genealogy and the deaths mentioned in the verse; the verse does not describe this scene.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man sits with four sons in a sunlit stone courtyard, with hills and trees beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering illustrates the relationship named in the verse; the setting, appearances, and gestures are artistic additions.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A father sits with three sons on a sunny hillside near a tent, with sheep and distant hills behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering illustrates the relationship named in the verse; the setting and activity are not specified in the text.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A large family gathers around a seated man and woman beneath a tree, near a pastoral tent and flock in a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering illustrates the verse’s genealogical summary; it does not depict a documented event or represent the stated total as a visual count.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded father sits with seven sons gathered around him near tents and grazing sheep in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering illustrates the relationship named in the verse; the setting, appearances, and moment are artistic inventions.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A family gathers beneath a tree beside a tent in a sunlit pastoral landscape. An older man sits among four younger men and a woman, while one man holds two boys close.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering illustrates the relationships named in the verse; the setting, ages and poses are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older woman and a bearded man sit among a multigenerational family at a pastoral encampment, surrounded by tents, woven fabrics, pottery, and distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering evokes Zilpah's family with Jacob; the verse records their relationship and number, not this particular gathering.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman and a man sit beneath a tree with two boys between them, in a sunny pastoral landscape with sheep and a tent.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family scene illustrates the relationships named in the verse; the verse does not describe this moment.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman and man sit affectionately with two boys in an Egyptian home overlooking a river and distant buildings.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family moment illustrates the relationships in the verse; the setting, ages, and moment are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man sits among a cheerful group of younger people outside a stone dwelling, beneath leafy branches.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering illustrates the list of Benjamin’s sons; the verse does not describe a gathering. The image includes an extra figure and does not identify the named sons individually.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Fourteen people of different ages gather together in a sunlit ancient courtyard, surrounded by stone walls and trees.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering evokes the verse’s count; the verse does not describe a gathering or identify the people shown.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A father and son sit together beneath a tree beside a tent, with sheep grazing in a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined father-and-son moment illustrates the relationship named in the verse; the setting and action are not specified in the text.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A father sits with four sons outside a sunlit dwelling, surrounded by grapevines and a distant pastoral landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering illustrates the relationship named in the verse; the setting, ages, and activity are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman sits beside a tent watching a family gathering in a sunlit landscape; seven smooth stones rest together in the foreground.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The family gathering and seven stones are an imaginative way to recall Bilhah and the seven persons counted in the verse, not a depiction of a described event.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Jacob walks with a staff among a multigenerational family caravan, with animals and bundles, overlooking a river valley and Egyptian buildings.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Jacob’s family journey to Egypt; the figures and setting are artistic details, not a literal count of the people in the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph stands with two boys beside him as a large family gathers in a sunlit Egyptian riverside landscape, with travelers, animals, fields and distant buildings.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering suggests the household counted in the verse; the composition does not depict seventy individually countable people.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler gestures toward a welcoming man as a family caravan arrives beside green fields and palms.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Judah going ahead toward Joseph and the travelers arriving in Goshen; the setting and figures are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A tearful Joseph embraces his elderly father Israel beside a horse-drawn chariot, with fertile fields and palms behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Joseph and Israel’s reunion in Goshen; the setting, clothing and surrounding details are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man and a younger man gaze at each other and clasp hands in a sunlit setting with palms and distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined meeting depicts Israel looking at Joseph with relief; the setting, clothing and gesture are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph, dressed in Egyptian clothing, gestures as he speaks to his gathered family among travel bundles and donkeys, with an Egyptian city in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Joseph speaking to his family before the report he intends to make to Pharaoh; the setting and details are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Shepherds walk through a sunny landscape with sheep, goats, and cattle, while donkeys carry bundles and household goods.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the shepherds and the animals and possessions they brought; the landscape and journey details are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Pharaoh sits in a sunlit Egyptian hall and gestures toward a group of attentive visitors standing before him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative royal audience pictures the question anticipated in the verse; the setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd gestures toward a flock of sheep and goats while an older man and a child with a lamb stand beside him. An Egyptian official faces them across a green pasture near a waterway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the family's pastoral livelihood and the prospect of dwelling in Goshen; the verse itself gives an instruction about what to say, rather than describing this encounter.
